issues.where: the orange film across both water crops, especially the right crop and the blue opening at the bottom of the left crop
issues.what: the surface pulls into long parallel brush streaks and a fringe of equally oriented orange fingers, making the film look like a stretched image laid across the lake
issues.fix: break up the directional stretch with different-sized patches of film, distinct edges that follow local ripples, and stretches of clear water

issues.where: the three larger animals in the center and their reflections
issues.what: the repeated barrel torsos and stiff, similarly bent legs make the herd look like copies of a clay model, with almost the same dry tan finish from torso to waterline
issues.fix: vary body proportions, weight shifts and leg spacing between animals, and darken the wetted parts with a distinct wet sheen

issues.where: top-right crop, the foreground animal's diagonal neck at the shoulder bend
issues.what: the skin ridges repeat in a tight stepped pattern that looks stamped onto the bend rather than folded by it, while the adjacent flank looks like sculpted clay
issues.fix: replace the repeated ridges with irregular folds that follow neck compression and vary the skin's fine texture and roughness

issues.where: top-center and bottom-left crops, the far side of the water below the scree
issues.what: a nearly straight translucent band separates the cliffs from the lake and blends into broad flat blue strips, giving the haze and water a layered-card look
issues.fix: vary mist density and height along the scree and break up the blue bands with irregular ripples and reflected shoreline detail

issues.where: the broad strip of foreground boulders below the herd
issues.what: many sizable stones have simple flat planes and knife-straight edges, making the near shore read as a scatter of faceted meshes despite the fine gravel between them
issues.fix: give the closest boulders irregular break faces, chipped or weathered edges, and more varied surface relief

issues.where: right crop, where the pale patch meets the dark orange-threaded water
issues.what: the pale patch lies over the dark surface as a broad soft color change with no distinct wet margin, relief, or change in ripple character
issues.fix: give the pale material an irregular wet perimeter with local height, gloss, and ripple changes where it meets the water

issues.where: top-left crop, around the background waders' feet and the smaller animal's lowered head
issues.what: the small dark tips end at the water plane with almost no local displacement; the general surface streaks continue past them, making the animals look placed on the sheet
issues.fix: anchor the individual contact points with small offset ripple rings, subtle waterline highlights and localized reflection distortion
